title: An adaptive variational algorithm for exact molecular simulations on a quantum computer
problem_summary: Introduces ADAPT-VQE: instead of a fixed ansatz, the circuit is grown one fermionic operator at a time from an operator pool, chosen adaptively to the molecule being simulated, producing shallower circuits with fewer parameters than a fixed UCCSD ansatz.

workflow_composition_notes: Iterative loop: evaluate gradients for every operator in the pool, append the highest-gradient operator to the ansatz, re-optimize all parameters via VQE, repeat until a convergence criterion is met.
